meta.parties: Carolis Appuhamy Et Al. v. Silva

rules.statement: An unsuccessful claimant under section 247 of the Civil Procedure Code cannot maintain an action if they have parted with their rights to the property in dispute before the seizure.
rules.supporting_quote: "The plaintiff who has not even a shadow of a title, as he has divested himself to whatever title he had, cannot possibly establish a title superior to that of the judgment-debtor"
